title.rendered: Information for New Incoming Kindergartners for 2023-2024

content.rendered:
Registration for Kindergarten is available online. You can find information and register online  HERE. Incoming Kindergarten students must turn 5 on or before September 1, 2023. Registering early helps the school and the district start planning for classrooms.

During online registration, new families can create a Sherwood ParentVUE account. Parents of current and former Sherwood students will log in with their existing ParentVUE account.

Paper registration packets are also available if preferred. The school office is closed for summer break June 26th – August 16th. During this time, you may pick up a packet at our District Office, Monday through Thursday, 8:00am-4:00pm. Their offices are located at 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd.

Please read the Kindergarten Special Edition newsletter with summer dates and kinder and kinder readiness information.
